summary: Give the engine the host-path-to-git-path rule and compose every harness path from a normalized state root

per.section: A fact the engine holds is reported, never rediscovered

acceptance: Every git path the package composes from a state root is slash-joined whatever dialect the engine reported it in, and the rule has one home the chain reads.
tests: the engine's path surface renders a backslash-separated relative path as a git path
the records gate matches a touched record under a backslash-separated state root
buildPromptArgs renders NOTE_PATH slash-joined from a backslash-separated state root
notes: computeStateRootRel returns relative(), so a nested root (a job dir) is host-dialect. chain.ts normalizes only the pending path (:177); noteGlob (:165), planStatePath/questionsPath/recordDirs (:176-181), isPark (:271), gates recordDirs (:261)/notePath (:276) and prompts noteRoot do not. Measured: fence rejects the note, isPark never true, records gate green over every record. Hand-rolls to fold in: builtinGates:236, git:403, job:173, vitestRunner:153, cascade:118.

summary: Read the clean-tree gate's status output NUL-separated so a quoted path is not a silent pass
acceptance: An untracked file inside the fence is refused whatever characters its name carries, and a refusal names the path as git spells it.

the clean-tree gate names a quoted tracked path without its quotes
